title: Overflow-flag update
statement: Let $w$ be a finite Boolean word, let $c$ be a configuration on input $w$, and let $j$ be a natural number. If the input head of $c$ is at the saturated position for $j$, then the disjunction of the test $|w|<j$ with the test that the scanned input symbol is blank is equivalent to $|w|<j+1$.
hypotheses_covered: The input head of $c$ equals the saturated position for $j$
replaced:
For a configuration whose input head is at the saturated position for $j$ on
input $w$, the disjunction of the flag recording $\abs{w} < j$ with the test
that the symbol read is blank equals the flag recording $\abs{w} < j + 1$.
